title: An update can wait in the parent
hook: A parent can record work that its descendants have not done yet.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Defer a segment-tree range addition in a lazy tag and push it only on partial descent.

misconception: Every range update must visit every changed leaf immediately.
objective: Defer a segment-tree range addition in a lazy tag and push it only on partial descent.

claims.text: The parent summary changes immediately while its add tag postpones descendant work. A partial query pushes the tag before descending, so deferred leaves cannot return their old values.
